name: journal
description: Offline-first journaling PWA — write anywhere, sync when you're back online

paragraphs: A calm, offline-first personal journaling PWA. Write, format, and attach photos with or without a connection; everything is stored locally first and synced to this server in the background when you're online. Installable to the home screen and fully usable in airplane mode.

Built with React + TypeScript + Vite, TipTap, Dexie (IndexedDB) and Tailwind. The server is one small Node process (server/) over SQLite, on the same box as the rest of carlosmartinezt.com. It used Supabase and Vercel until 16 Oct 2026; Supabase kept pausing the free project, so it moved home.
Ways to navigate your journal (all offline, reading from IndexedDB):
features: Timeline — reverse-chronological with sticky month separators and a
Calendar — a scrolling month grid with entry-days highlighted; tap a day
On This Day — everything written on today's calendar day across all years.
Search — instant full-text search over titles and body text.

requirements.text: The login screen has a See a demo link (or go straight to /demo) which opens a fictional two-year journal — no account, no sign-up.
